summary: Correct the canonical threads composition's main-integration adapters for ordinary signed messages and Swift collection sockets

replay.detail: No stored claims or replay rules change.

schema.detail: Ordinary device-signed thread messages remain unbound to mission effect owners; signed fields and wire schemas are unchanged.

rules.detail: No authority or retention rules change. Effect-bound native sends remain restricted to attested workers.

compatibility.detail: The thread signature adapter explicitly supplies no effect owner, matching the ordinary-message contract added on main. The Swift collection socket factory exposes the existing ClientWebSocket protocol used by both URLSession and local-socket transports.

downtime.detail: No migration or restart sequence changes.

recovery.detail: No upgrade state changes to recover.
